adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` use `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` without handling the nil case. If the id is missing/invalid (or the record was deleted), `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...` on nil and `destroy` will call `host.destroy`, causing a 500. This not-found handling issue is present in the diff and untested (the only added controller spec checks ancestry). The claimed frontend params mismatch is not directly verifiable from the diff, but the nil-on-missing-id 500 is.
